checks.text: The page shows the heading "Periodic Table", a search field labelled "Search elements", a data grid with a column header "Symbol", and a checkbox labelled "Show only metals".

Typing "Hyd" in the field labelled "Search elements" shows a results list containing the item "Hydrogen (H)"; clicking that item updates the data grid to show a row where the "Symbol" cell is "H" and the "Name" cell is "Hydrogen".
With the grid showing Hydrogen, pressing the Down arrow key moves focus to the next row, which shows "Symbol" "He" and "Name" "Helium".
Typing "Carbon" in the field labelled "Search elements" and clicking the result "Carbon (C)" shows a grid row with "Symbol" "C", "Name" "Carbon", and "Category" "Nonmetal".
With the grid showing Carbon, clicking the checkbox labelled "Show only metals" removes the Carbon row and shows the text "No elements match the current filter".

Unchecking "Show only metals" and typing "Iron" in the field labelled "Search elements", then clicking the result "Iron (Fe)", shows a grid row with "Symbol" "Fe", "Name" "Iron", and "Category" "Metal".
With the grid showing Iron, clicking the button "Copy details" places the exact text "Iron (Fe) | Metal | 55.845" on the clipboard.
Typing "Zinc" in the field labelled "Search elements" and clicking the result "Zinc (Zn)" shows a grid row with "Symbol" "Zn", "Name" "Zinc", and "Category" "Metal".

Reload keeps the filter state: after checking "Show only metals", searching for "Iron", and reloading the page, the checkbox "Show only metals" is checked and the grid shows a row with "Symbol" "Fe" and "Name" "Iron".
